protocol_name: R2 measured temporal forecasting budget and paired-uncertainty audit
prior_holdout_status: 2017 results were already reported in R1; this is a reused-holdout robustness audit, not pristine external confirmation.
meter_selection: First six lexicographic sites with >=2 eligible buildings; first Education and Office building per site where available, lexicographic fallback; eligibility uses ONLY Jan-Oct 2016: >=95% nonnegative finite meter values, median >1 kWh, SD >1 kWh, positive published floor area.
data: Exact R1 preprocessing and valid-window bindings. No changed buildings, cleaning, targets, imputation, normalizers or historical inputs.
training_pool: All eligible Jan-Oct2016 sequences, expected84928; verified after exact preparation.
diagnostic_train_pool: The original6800 evenly spaced eligible training sequence indices; eval mode only for learning curves.
optimizer: AdamW, original learning rate, weight_decay=0.0001, gradient_clip=5; no schedule or new hyperparameter search.
validation_curve: Every epoch: fixed diagnostic training and entire validation normalized objective MSE, meter RMSE and MAE; no 2017 losses in training script.

extension_rule.mean_curve: Arithmetic mean validation RMSE of seeds11,23,37, per architecture.
extension_rule.extend_if: Any model gains at least0.005 in last5epochs, or earliest global minimum lies in last2epochs. Extend ALL models/seeds to next cap, preserving optimizer/RNG states.
extension_rule.at_cap: Record unresolved budget sensitivity and retain validation-selected checkpoint without a convergence claim.

checkpoint_rule: For each architecture choose earliest epoch attaining minimal mean validation RMSE across all3seeds. Use the same epoch for its3seeds. Never drop a seed or select using test.
update_landmark_scope: Validation-only equal-update diagnostic; not equal-compute or pure sample-size causal attribution.
final_test_gate: Create DECISIONS_LOCK.json with all budgets/checkpoints/validation hashes before score_test.py can read predictions or score2017.

uncertainty.point_metrics: Mean of three seed-specific pooled metrics, and paired per-building differences. Never substitute ensemble error.
uncertainty.primary_interval: 5000 paired moving-calendar-block resamples;14days; within calendar quarter; synchronized time draws across buildings/models/seeds; fixed12building panel.
uncertainty.site_time_sensitivity: Resample six site clusters with replacement, retaining both buildings per chosen site; same synchronized quarter time blocks.
uncertainty.seed_handling: Fitted seed models held fixed; initialization SD reported separately, not treated as building/time uncertainty.
uncertainty.missingness: Resample complete calendar days including original common-row masks; recompute denominators. No hour-iid resampling or compression across gaps.
uncertainty.inference_scope: Pointwise95% exploratory percentile intervals conditional on selected data, fitted models and quarter-stratified2017 time process. Six deterministic sites do not justify population/site-transfer inference.
uncertainty.multiplicity: No confirmatory ranking or superiority tests; comparators/secondary metrics exploratory; no economic or formal equivalence claim.

legacy_preservation: R1 five-epoch6800-window outputs remain separate fixed-budget reference; paired uncertainty is reported separately for legacy and validation-selected extended runs.
